entries.note: NEW finding for TASK-4: delete is REST DELETE /api/custom-fonts/<id> (204 No Content), not a GraphQL mutation. So across the 3 writes observed this run: create=REST POST /api/custom-fonts, rename=GraphQL mutation update_custom_fonts on /v1/graphql, delete=REST DELETE /api/custom-fonts/<id>. Reads (list/search/pagination) all go through GraphQL /v1beta1/relay. Mixed REST+GraphQL backend, not pure Hasura as old KB implied (old KB only looked at reads).
